units.source_text: 狗店老板在两只狗的脑袋上弯下腰来，伸开手掌拍了一下公狗的臀部。

en.t: The dog shop owner bent down over the heads of the two dogs, spread out his palm, and gave the male dog a slap on the rump.

units.source_text: 小宠犬钻到夫人的衣服下方，一边摇着尾巴，一边将脑袋和前脚趴下，蜿蜒起伏地磨蹭着身子。

en.t: The little pet dog slipped under the lady's clothes, wagging its tail as it lowered its head and front paws and rubbed its body against her in a wriggling motion.
